name: Debug Tools
author: KFII-PC
description: Noclip flight, invincibility, infinite MP, a speed multiplier, position bookmarks, area warp and an editor for the character -- experience, level, HP/MP, gold, the two base attributes, the five condition timers and the status screen's seventeen combat ratings -- with a live readout of the player state the port has identified so far. A dockable panel plus hotkeys; everything is off until you turn it on.
